01 / THE AMBITION

A bioscience future,
built with purpose.

Bioscience Research and Medical Cannabis Innovation in Jamaica

Double9 Ventures is a Jamaican-based bioscience and controlled-environment agriculture company developing a medical cannabis cultivation and research platform for international medical markets.

Our vision is to help establish Jamaica as a globally recognized center for bioscience research, pharmaceutical-grade medical cannabis, advanced manufacturing, and plant-based innovation. Scientific excellence and strategic collaboration are central to that ambition.

As the platform develops, we aim to build toward applicable EU Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements and pursue the certifications and approvals needed for intended activities and markets.

FROM VISION TO CAPABILITY

One connected ambition.
Six areas of development.

Cultivation

Develop controlled growing environments with a focus on consistency, quality, and research.

Applied research

Connect plant science with the questions that guide product development and practical applications.

Advanced manufacturing

Build capabilities to translate research into carefully developed, quality-focused products.

Technology transfer

Bring knowledge, processes, and expertise into the local bioscience ecosystem.

Education

Support the skills and scientific capabilities that a sustainable industry needs.

International commercialization

Develop pathways to international medical markets, subject to relevant requirements and approvals.
